d:
Jharkhand vidhanasbha men SIR (Special Intensive Revision) ko lekar bulae gae vishesh satr par vidhayak saryu ray ne bara saval uthaya hai. unhonne hemant soren sarkar par nishana sadhte hue kaha ki vishesh satr bulakar sarkari paise ki barbadi ki ja rahi hai. aakhir saryu ray ne sarkar se aur kya saval kie? dekhie unka pura bayana.
